_meta.purpose: Web Step 2 — Stage new or updated rows for `public/data/songs.json` before merging (couplings, disc links, corrections). Rosters/edits to group rows go in groups_update.json; idol profiles stay in idols.json.
_meta.merge_rules_summary: Upsert by song `uid`. Objects deep-merge when both sides are plain objects; arrays on the patch replace the canonical array for that field.
